neighbours.label: the last piece of a scientific term after 'beta' (beta-alanine, beta-amyloid, Beta Pictoris)
fire: The supplement contains beta-carotene and vitamin E.
Levels of beta-endorphin rise during long runs.
Penicillin belongs to the beta-lactam antibiotics.
Oats are rich in beta-glucan and other fibres.
Plaques of beta-amyloid were seen in the tissue.
The shell of Beta Lyrae is easy to observe.
Food makers add beta-sitosterol to some spreads.
The bright star Beta Cygni is a double.
quiet: The supplement contains carotene and vitamin E.
Levels of endorphin rise during long runs.
Penicillin belongs to the older antibiotics.
Oats are rich in starch and other fibres.
Plaques of protein were seen in the tissue.
The shell of Vega is easy to observe.
Food makers add sterols to some spreads.
The bright star Albireo is a double.

notes: 'Alpha Centauri' (0.07) and 'Gamma Cephei' (0.00) stayed quiet in probes where 'Beta Centauri' reached 0.73. The card's 'Lensing' and '-phase' are not covered by this label.
